resources.string:
This app records your voice so Quantilytix can build a synthetic version of it for Smart-Q.

1. PURPOSE. Your recorded voice will be used to train a text-to-speech (synthetic voice) model. That model will generate spoken replies inside the Smart-Q product.

2. USE. The synthetic voice will be trained and deployed for Smart-Q, and may be used commercially by Quantilytix as part of the Smart-Q product, including for paying customers.

3. STORAGE. Your raw recordings and derived training data are stored on Hugging Face in a private, access-controlled repository. Every upload is staged as a pull request and reviewed by a person before it is merged into the training data.

4. RETENTION. Recordings and the trained voice model are retained for as long as Smart-Q uses this voice, or until you withdraw consent under item 5, whichever is sooner.

5. WITHDRAWAL. You may withdraw consent at any time by notifying Quantilytix. On withdrawal, your raw recordings will be deleted from storage and the voice will be scheduled for retirement from production use. Deletion of a fully trained model's learned parameters cannot be done selectively; withdrawal stops further use and deletes the source recordings.

6. SCOPE. This synthetic voice is for Smart-Q only. It will not be licensed, sold, or reused for any other product without asking you again, separately, for that specific use.

7. DISCLOSURE. Smart-Q will disclose to its end users that voice replies are generated by a synthetic voice, not a live person.

By continuing, you confirm you understand and agree to the above.
